text:
Alice W: Quick sync for the webinar launch posts + landing: need final SEO pass (keywords, schema, internal links, redirects). Goal: lock content by EOD.
Miguel R: I'll split keywords into three buckets per post: intent, shorttail, longtail. Will add to the doc.
Chloe (Content): Draft headlines uploaded. Adding 160-char metas and OG images. Do we want webinar schema + FAQ schema?
Leo (Devex): FAQ schema would be good for recap post to get rich snippets. Place JSON-LD in head. For client-side pages, pre-render. Example snippet pasted below.
seo-bot: Auto-check: duplicate title tags between post A and landing; missing H1 on post B.
Miguel R: I'll propose anchor texts for internal links: landing -> /product-inference ("LLM inference platform"), benchmark -> /benchmarks ("inference benchmarks"), recap -> /webinar-signup ("watch the on-demand webinar").
Chloe (Content): For redirects: old /webinars/serve-llms-2023 -> new landing /webinar/serve-llms-2026. Preserve utm params.
Leo (Devex): Implementing nginx redirect: `if ($request_uri ~* "^/webinars/(.*)") { return 301 $scheme://$host/webinar/$1?$query_string; }` Will whitelist known slugs.
Alice W: Decision: keep canonical per evergreen post, redirect only duplicate splash pages. Chloe, mark duplicates in the sheet.
Miguel R: Adding SERP intent label per keyword: informational/commercial/transactional.
Chloe (Content): Added FAQ pairs for post C. Example Q: "How does Redwood reduce inference cost?" A: summary.
seo-bot: Next audit scheduled after deploy. Remember to ping CDN invalidation for OG image.
Alice W: Thanks. I'll update the ops card with owners. Ping me if you hit blockers before 4pm PT.
